d: Chestnut brown hair is styled into two large, voluminous curls framing the face, with thick bangs across the forehead and a red ribbon tied at the back. The eyes are a deep crimson shade with a gentle, smiling expression, set on a youthful face with the maturity of a teenager. A slender build is dressed in a layered pink and maroon kimono with a green obi sash. Signature details include a small silver anchor ornament attached to the waist of the garment and a traditional hand-held brush.
